description: List error, slow-SQL, deprecation, warning or notice issues of a project, newest occurrence first, 10 per page, with the total count. Use to find what is failing or slow and how often. Reads all services unless "service" is passed or configured; "transactionIds" narrows to issues of given transactions. One type and one status per call. There is no time filter; use lastOccurred to judge recency.

detail.description: "concise" (default) returns a trimmed summary. "full" also includes the unmodified API response under "raw"; it can be very large.

environment.description: Environment, e.g. "production" or "staging". Defaults to the configured environment, else production; criteria.environment (traces: each trace's environment) shows which was used. When results come back, an unknown name fails with an error.

project.description: Tideways project as "project" or "organization/project". Defaults to the defaultProject that tideways_list_projects reports; call it for valid names.

service.description: Service, e.g. "web" or "worker". Defaults to the configured service, else all services of the project; tideways_list_services lists them.

status.description: open (default) = unresolved; all = open and ignored together; resolved, ignored and not_error are triaged states; "new" currently returns the same list as "open".

transactionIds.description: Only issues raised in these transactions: numeric IDs from transactions[].id of tideways_get_performance.

type.description: error = exceptions and fatal errors, slowsql = slow SQL queries, deprecated = deprecations, warning = PHP warnings, notice = PHP notices

name: tideways_list_issues

service.description: Service whose issues were read; null = all services

hasMore.description: True when later pages exist; request the next page for more

durationMs.description: Slow SQL queries: duration of the query in ms; null for other types

message.description: Last message or SQL, truncated to 500 characters

occurrences.description: All occurrences since firstOccurred, not limited to any period

occurrencesSinceLastRelease.description: Occurrences since the last release marker

originatingFunction.description: Always null; source names the code

title.description: Exception class, or the tables of a slow SQL query

topFrame.description: Always null: tideways_get_issue returns the stack trace; source names the file and line

transactionCount.description: Always null: tideways_get_issue returns the affected transactions

transactions.description: Always null: tideways_get_issue returns the affected transactions with counts; filter the list by transaction with "transactionIds"

type.description: The requested type; tideways_get_issue takes it with the id

raw.description: Unmodified Tideways API response; present only when detail is "full".

totalItems.description: Issues matching the filters on all pages

title: List issues
